one_line: Show one whole make-then-squash process in real time and end on the child laughing, no talking needed.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a girl about 8 to 10 smiles at the lens behind a stone table outdoors, hands over a closed pink kit box. No speech, no text. A photo-collage transition at 1 to 2 s, then she opens the box.
q1_hook.why: A smiling child and a bright box make a pleasant picture, but nothing is said, written or promised in 0 to 3 s (H1, T3, H6). The kit and its value are not clear until the cake appears (H2). A face with no voice is half of H4. The collage is the only motion (E1).

beats.what: She opens the pink box on the table; collage and flip transitions
beats.why: A slow, silent start with effects

beats.what: She pulls foil sachets from the box and shows them
Sachets lined in a row, bowl and pink stand; she opens a bag, clay goes in
She kneads yellow clay into layers on the stand; glitch and black-and-white transitions
beats.why: The build starts to look like a cake

beats.what: Pipes teal and white cream with a syringe tool onto the small cake
beats.why: A new tool and new colours

beats.what: Pink trim, sprinkles and candy balls from a pack, in close-ups
beats.why: Finishing touches, close enough to see

beats.what: She holds the finished cake to the lens, a finger raised
beats.why: The proud result, held back until now

beats.what: She squashes it into slime, stretches it, laughing
beats.why: The delight beat the Reel builds to

beats.what: She holds up the box, sets it down; black frame

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: The caption's first line is a rhetorical question, "מי אמר שממתקים מיועדים רק לאכילה?", not an ask. Only ask: follow. No comment, save or share prompt.
q2_flow.why: Build, then reveal, then smash is a clear arc with the best moment at 0:47 to 0:58 (K2, R4). But the first 20 s are setup with no stated reason to stay (H1, R1), and 6 to 14 s real-time holds carry little new information (R3). The black frame at the end adds a tail (E8).

q3_cta.what: None in the video. Caption, before the hashtags: "תעקבו לעוד התנסויות וכיף 💜". No link, price or where to buy.
q3_cta.why: A generic follow ask below the fold gives no reason beyond more fun (C6, C2). The video asks nothing and offers no path to the kit (C6). It does keep to one ask only (C1).

q4_shown.what: A girl about 8 to 10 opens the box, lines up foil sachets, kneads clay, pipes and decorates a small cake in real time, shows it, then squashes it into slime. Box held up at 0:58. No price, no text, no adult.
q4_shown.why: The whole process, from box to result to a laugh, is shown in use (S1, F8), with the child's delight as the peak (K8, K1). Nothing states a benefit, price or where to buy. A face with no name in the caption is lower risk than the others (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 10 shots in 63 s (first pass), mostly 6 to 14 s fixed real-time takes, joined by about ten effect transitions: collage frames, a flip, glitch, black and white, torn paper, split screen. No speed changes. No text. Ends on a black frame.
q5_edit.why: Long real-time takes let the process be followed, but few cuts means slow pacing (E2, R3). The heavy transitions draw attention from the product. With no voice and no text, nothing carries the message muted or not (E4, T1).

q6_topic.what: A child builds a slime dessert from a kit and then squashes it; it serves kids and parents looking for a messy, satisfying activity.
q6_topic.why: Building something just to squash it is a recognisable child moment with a laugh (K3, K1). With nothing said, no practical value is passed on (K4), and no parent worry or occasion is named (K6, K7).

q7_filmed.what: Vertical phone footage in bright daylight by a pool: fixed medium frame, the girl centred behind a stone table, hands visible; closer handheld inserts around 0:24 to 0:41. Sharp and well lit.
q7_filmed.why: Bright even light, a steady frame and visible hands make the process easy to follow (F7, E6, F4). The table fills the lower 40% of the wide frame and the kit looks small (F4). The polished resort setting looks less like a plain home clip (H8).

q8_text.on_screen: No on-screen text or subtitles in any frame from 0:00 to 1:02. No watermark. The brand name appears only on the packaging, for example on a sachet at 0:39.
q8_text.caption: "מי אמר שממתקים מיועדים רק לאכילה? 😜🍭". About 36 words: a playful line, the product name in Latin letters, a benefit line, a follow ask, 5 English hashtags (#SlimeFun, #fyp and others). No disclosure.
q8_text.why: With no voice and no text the viewer gets pictures but no message, so topic and benefit live only in the caption (T1, T3). The caption's first line is a hook, but its hashtags are generic and English (T7). The collaboration with palphot is not disclosed (T8, S7).

weak_points: No text or voice in 63 s; nothing promised in the first 3 s; heavy transition effects; long silent holds; a black end frame; generic English hashtags; the palphot collaboration is not disclosed.
lumebook_takeaway: Film one steady, real-time unboxing of a LumeBook book with hands only, end on a page spread, and add a text line in the first second.
not_verified: Music (the transcript is "תודה רבה" only, so no speech; music not established); whether the girl is the account owner's child; what palphot supplied; the number and timing of transitions (read from 1 s frames); packaging text beyond the brand name.
